description: This file defines the TaxClass entity class used in a Java-based e-commerce system, representing tax classifications with relationships to products, tax rates, and merchant stores.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax classification, including code, title, associated products, merchant store, and tax rates.

methods.name: TaxClass
methods.description: Constructor initializing TaxClass with a specified code.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the TaxClass.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the TaxClass.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the tax class.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the tax class.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifying the tax class.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the list of tax rates associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets the list of tax rates for this tax class.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this tax class.
